concepts.def: Cation gains e-, anion loses e-
Shows e- transfer at one electrode
Salt solution; electrolysed to give Cl2, H2, NaOH

walkthroughs.body_html:
Cathode (negative): cations reduced.

Cu^2+ + 2e- -> Cu.

Anode (positive): anions oxidised.

Brine = aq NaCl. Cathode: H2; anode: Cl2; solution: NaOH.

Used to make bleach, PVC and soaps.

Fe in Haber process, V2O5 in Contact process.

TM compounds colour glass and ceramics.
